app.dac_steps:
Android usually mixes and resamples USB audio itself, so bit-perfect playback needs a player with its own USB driver.

Player Pure (the Music tile): connect the DAC, let Android open Player Pure for it and tick "Always". Player Pure › Settings shows the DAC, and Now Playing says "Bit-perfect". Leave Digital volume off and set the level on the DAC or amplifier.

HiBy Music also works: let HiBy use the DAC, then turn on exclusive USB output in its settings, with EQ, MSEB and effects off.

Check: the DAC's sample-rate display should follow each track (44.1 kHz, 96 kHz and so on). Only one app can hold the DAC at a time.

app.input_service_summary: Lets the Media Home web remote move a pointer, tap, scroll and type
app.input_service_description: Lets the Media Home web remote (PIN-protected, home Wi-Fi only) use your phone as a touchpad and keyboard: it moves an on-screen pointer, taps, scrolls, goes Back or Home, and types into the text field you selected. It acts only on commands from the remote and does not collect or send anything.

app.yt_key_none: Not set - needed for YouTube search from the web remote (free; tap for how to get one)
app.yt_key_bad: That is not a YouTube API key (it starts with AIza and has 39 characters)

app.set_remote_qr_home_sub: Shows the remote's code in the Browser tile while no phone or PC has the remote open. The Browser tile comes back as soon as one connects, and the code returns about 15 seconds after the last one closes the remote or locks.
app.saver_on: On: after %1$d min without use, the tablet shows the clock, the weather and the music that is playing instead of turning the screen off.
app.saver_off: Off: Android's screen saver is not set to Media Home. Tap "Android screen saver settings" below, choose Media Home clock and "While charging".
app.saver_unknown: Android doesn't say which screen saver is chosen. If it is Media Home clock, it starts after %1$d min without use.
app.saver_rules: It starts only while the tablet is plugged in (Android's rule); on battery the screen turns off as usual. Touch the screen to go back to what was open.
app.saver_stay_awake: "Stay awake while charging" is on (in Developer options), so the screen never times out and the screen saver can't start. Turn it off there.
app.saver_keep_on: "Keep the screen on" (above) keeps the screen on while the home screen is showing, so the screen saver starts only from other apps.
app.saver_preview_sub: Shows the screen saver now. Touch to close.
app.saver_need_write: Allow Media Home to "Modify system settings" first, then try again.
app.saver_show_music: Show the music that is playing
app.saver_android_sub: Choose Media Home clock and "While charging"

app.wx_city_auto: Automatic: %1$s (from the tablet's time zone) - tap to choose a city
app.wx_here_now: Current location: %1$s. Follows the tablet when it moves.
app.wx_here_need_permission: Current location - tap to allow approximate location. Until then: %1$s
app.wx_here_location_off: Current location - Location is off on the tablet (tap to open its settings). Until then: %1$s
app.wx_here_searching: Current location - looking for it… Until then: %1$s
app.wx_use_city_sub: Search for a city; the weather then stays on that city
app.wx_use_here_sub: Weather for wherever the tablet is (approximate location, the default)
app.wx_privacy: Location is approximate and rounded to about 1 km. Only the rounded coordinates go to Open-Meteo for the forecast; the place name comes from Android's own geocoder.
app.wx_search_failed: Could not search - check the internet connection
app.wx_no_match: No city found with that name
app.wx_attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (free, no account). Updates every 30 minutes.
app.setup_row_sub: Permissions and options, step by step: home screen, music, remote, screen saver
app.setup_intro: Welcome to Media Home Pure. Each step below is optional: tap it, allow it on Android's page, then come back with Back. You can open this list again any time from Settings › Set up.
app.setup_todo: Not yet - tap to set up
app.setup_optional: Optional - tap to add your key
app.setup_unknown: Android doesn't say - tap to check
app.setup_home_why: Media Home Pure opens when you press Home. To go back to your usual home screen: Settings › Switch back to the standard home screen.
app.setup_notif_why: Lets the music player and the web remote keep running in the background, with a notification you can see.
app.setup_files_why: Player Pure finds the music on this device and on USB drives. The web remote's Files tab can browse, upload, rename and delete.
app.setup_playing_why: The home screen, the screen saver and the web remote show and control the music from any app.
app.setup_restricted: Switch greyed out? Android blocks it for apps installed from a file: open App info (below) › ⋮ › Allow restricted settings, then try again.
app.setup_location_why: Rounded to about 1 km. Without it, the weather uses a city you choose in Settings › Weather.
app.setup_location_off: Allowed, but Location is off - tap to turn it on
app.setup_remote_why: Control music, video and apps from a phone or computer browser on the same Wi-Fi. Protected by a PIN.
app.pin_message: 4 to 8 digits. Phones signed in with the old PIN have to sign in again.
app.pin_bad: The PIN must be 4 to 8 digits
app.setup_overlay_why: Lets the web remote open apps while another app is on the screen.
app.setup_input_why: Use the phone as a touchpad and keyboard. In Accessibility, turn on "Media Home remote mouse & keyboard".
app.setup_youtube_title: YouTube search from the web remote
app.setup_youtube_why: Needs your own free YouTube Data API key (about 5 minutes, once). YouTube itself works without it.
app.setup_saver_title: Screen saver: clock, weather and music
app.setup_saver_why: In Android's screen saver settings choose Media Home clock and "While charging". It starts only while the device is charging.
app.setup_timeout_why: Lets Settings › Screen saver › Start after change Android's screen timeout.
app.setup_app_info_sub: Android's page for this app: permissions, and ⋮ › Allow restricted settings
app.setup_manual_sub: Step-by-step help in English and Vietnamese (opens a web page)
app.setup_finish_sub: Go to the home screen. Anything left can be done later.
app.yt_key_restrict: Paste your own key below. To protect it, restrict it in Google Cloud Console: Android apps, package name %1$s, SHA-1 %2$s; API restriction: YouTube Data API v3.
